meta_and_positioning.design_persona: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer (Premium Botanical B2B)
meta_and_positioning.positioning_statement: FloraSetu is a modern, calm, trustworthy, and ultra-efficient B2B floriculture procurement engine. It bridges growers, wholesalers, florists, and logistics with operational clarity and botanical warmth. It avoids generic ERP/database clutter, wedding-app pink, and consumer gifting aesthetics in favor of clean high-density information architecture, explicit action hierarchy, and tactile physical feedback.
meta_and_positioning.emotional_tone: Grounded, calm, authoritative, precise, transparent, and responsive.
meta_and_positioning.design_context: B2B Marketplace PWA with Mobile-First operations (Buyer/Supplier/QC/Driver) and Desktop-Heavy Control Planes (Ops/Admin)
meta_and_positioning.dark_mode_stance: Light Theme Default with warm botanical ivory (#F8F8F5) and deep forest emerald (#183D33). High contrast light mode minimizes outdoor glare for field operations (farms, hubs, delivery vehicles). Dark mode is reserved exclusively for darkroom logistics/night hubs if enabled via user preference.

color_system.contrast_policy: All text elements MUST adhere to WCAG 2.2 AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text, 3:1 for large text). Primary interactive elements use #183D33 on #FFFFFF or #FFFFFF on #183D33 (ratio > 11:1).

typography_system.font_family_fallback_indian: 'Noto Sans Devnagari', 'Noto Sans Tamil', 'Noto Sans Telugu', sans-serif
typography_system.numeric_emphasis: All prices, stem counts, percentages, and lot numbers must use tabular figures font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for vertical alignment in tables and cards.

spacing_and_layout_system.card_radii: 14px (rounded-2xl) for primary containers, 10px (rounded-xl) for nested cards, 6px (rounded-lg) for buttons and inputs

buyer.nav_type_mobile: Bottom Bar (5 items: Home, Offers, Orders, Events, More)
buyer.nav_type_desktop: Left Collapsible Sidebar + Sticky Header with Active Org Switcher

supplier.nav_type_mobile: Bottom Bar (4 items: Home, Requests, Supply, Orders)
supplier.nav_type_desktop: Left Collapsible Sidebar + Quick Supply Floating CTA

partner.nav_type_mobile: Touch-Optimized Field Shell (Task Switcher Header + Large Cards)

ops.nav_type_desktop: Left Technical Nav + Top Filter Bar + Exception Control Tower Header

admin.nav_type_desktop: Left Control Plane Sidebar + System Governance TopBar

component_inventory_and_specifications.AppShell: Layout wrapper managing org switching, navigation, breadcrumbs, user profile, and shell switcher.
component_inventory_and_specifications.WorkspaceSwitcher: Header dropdown showing current active organization, role badge, and fast switch list.
component_inventory_and_specifications.ActionCenter: Prioritized action panel showing pending quotes, orders arriving, and document corrections.
component_inventory_and_specifications.PrimaryActionCard: Bold 14px radius card with primary background/border and single high-visibility CTA.
component_inventory_and_specifications.OfferComparison: Desktop 4-column spec comparison table with stem length, bloom stage, grade, price, freight, and match rating; transforms to stacked cards on mobile.
component_inventory_and_specifications.OrderTimeline: Plain-language step list showing past completed milestones, active state, and expected future steps with owner tag.
component_inventory_and_specifications.EvidenceGallery: Grid of thumbnail images with zoom modal, timestamp overlay, and defect tagging pins for QC/Claims.
component_inventory_and_specifications.ProgressStepper: Multi-step progress indicator for KYB and Quick Request with clear numbers, titles, and completed checkmarks.
component_inventory_and_specifications.SearchableSelect: Accessible search-as-you-type dropdown with clear zero-results state and multi-script keyboard navigation.
component_inventory_and_specifications.DataTable: Clean non-bordered internal desktop table with sort headers, sticky column actions, and mobile MobileDataCard fallback.

responsive_and_breakpoint_behavior_rules.tables: Desktop displays full multi-column grid with sticky right actions. Mobile converts every row into an actionable MobileDataCard with primary metric highlighted.
responsive_and_breakpoint_behavior_rules.drawers_and_modals: Desktop uses right-hand SideSheet drawer (480px) for contextual details. Mobile uses bottom slide-up Drawer with drag handle and safe-area padding.
responsive_and_breakpoint_behavior_rules.forms: Desktop uses 2-column or 3-column structured form grid with max-width 768px. Mobile uses single column form with fixed bottom sticky submit bar.
responsive_and_breakpoint_behavior_rules.camera_intake: Mobile camera integration launches native capture with live crop grid and photo thumbnail queue. Desktop provides drag-and-drop file uploader.

motion_and_micro_interactions.duration_normal: 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) (drawer slide, modal overlay, accordion expansion)
motion_and_micro_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: All motion transitions disabled automatically when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is set; falls back to instant opacity toggle.

accessibility_and_wcag22_checklist.keyboard_navigation: All interactive buttons, cards, and inputs reachable via Tab / Shift+Tab. Focus ring is 2px solid #183D33 with 2px offset.
accessibility_and_wcag22_checklist.touch_targets: All mobile buttons, chips, tabs, and list items have minimum hit target of 44x44px.
accessibility_and_wcag22_checklist.test_attributes: Every interactive element MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='quick-request-submit-button').
accessibility_and_wcag22_checklist.screen_readers: Icons marked with aria-hidden='true'. Dynamic status changes announced via aria-live='polite' region.

external_wizard.status_banner: Human readable status indicator with exact reason if correction is requested by Ops.

internal_reviewer_console.layout: Split-screen layout (50% Organization & Doc Metadata | 50% Interactive PDF/Image Document Viewer)
internal_reviewer_console.decision_bar: Sticky bottom bar with three explicit actions: [Approve Organization] [Request Document Correction] [Reject Verification]
internal_reviewer_console.audit_trail: Immutable chronological timeline of all verification actions, document uploads, and staff notes.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are the main execution agent responsible for realizing the FloraSetu redesign.
Do not change business logic, backend APIs, authorization rules, or domain entity models.
Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the workspace.
Implement the 5 role shells (/buyer, /supplier, /partner, /ops, /admin) with distinct color accents, clear navigation bars, and active organization header switchers.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Use Lucide React icons for all status badges and navigation icons.
Use Sonner for toast notifications and inline feedback banners.
Ensure all forms use single-column mobile layouts with sticky bottom submit bars.
Never use generic placeholder images or lorem ipsum text in transaction screens.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain 2-3x generous spacing across cards and layout containers to avoid cramped UI.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: Every interactive button, input, link, tab, and card MUST include data-testid='kebab-case-id'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.theme: Use light mode warm ivory (#F8F8F5) with deep botanical green (#183D33) as primary accent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Use Inter font family with tabular numeric alignment for all price and stem count values.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.components: Reuse pre-existing Shadcn js primitives in /src/components/ui/.
